items.passage: Transcript: Hi everyone, this is Ingrid Solano from the chemistry teaching lab, with an update on the make-up for anyone who missed the titration experiment. The syllabus lists it for Wednesday at nine thirty in the morning, in Room 131, where the regular sections meet. That room is getting new fume hoods that week, so the make-up is moving to Room 226 in the Arden Building, and since 226 is booked on Wednesdays, it will run on Tuesday. My first message said Tuesday at nine thirty, but the teaching assistants have a seminar then, so we'll start at ten thirty. You don't need to email me to hold a bench; there's plenty of space. The data sheet is different. There won't be spare copies in 226, so collect one from the stockroom window in the lobby before you come. Teaching assistants will sign notebooks at the end, as usual. And the online safety quiz you took in September still counts, so there's no need to retake it.

Have a teaching assistant sign their lab notebook

"Send the lab coordinator an email to reserve a bench" is wrong: "You don't need to email me to hold a bench; there's plenty of space." "Retake the online safety quiz from September" is wrong: the September quiz "still counts, so there's no need to retake it." "Have a teaching assistant sign their lab notebook" is wrong: notebooks are signed "at the end, as usual," not in advance.
